name: Hafinen
description_en:
Hafinen is a product in the Human resources category. Its directory profile covers Training Management, Time Off Management, Recruiting Management, Performance Appraisal, Payroll Management, Onboarding, Employee Lifecycle Management, Employee Database.

Additional listed capabilities include HR Compliance Management, Time & Attendance Management, Applicant Tracking. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: prepare payroll records and payment calculations; store structured information about employees; track candidates through a hiring process. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
